children: B&R Technology Merger Corp. reported results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026, recording a consolidated net loss of $(82,690) for the six-month period and $(70,443) for the quarter. The company has not commenced operations and generated no operating revenues through June 30, 2026.
Net income (loss): $(82,690) for the six months ended June 30, 2026; $(70,443) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Diluted EPS: $(0.01) basic and diluted net loss per Class B ordinary share for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026.
Revenue: No operating revenues reported through June 30, 2026 (company has not commenced operations).
Completed an IPO and private placement, placing approximately $360M in trust to fund a technology and AI-focused business combination.
Actively sourcing acquisition targets in AI-tailwinds technology growth sectors; will generate operating revenues only after completing a business combination.
As a public blank-check company, it has incurred increased public company costs and established administrative services to support pre-combination operations.
Must complete a business combination by July/October 2028 (subject to extension) or liquidate and redeem public shares per its timeline and liquidity plan.
